The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1942–1943''' was contested by 52 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[ADO Den Haag|ADO]] won this year's championship by beating [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]], [[Sportclub Enschede|SC Enschede]] and [[SC Heerenveen|Heerenveen]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]] 
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Maurits (football club)|Maurits]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[Hermes DVS]] and [[Sparta Rotterdam]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Volewijckers|De Volewijckers]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[AFC Ajax]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]] and [[VUC (football club)|VUC]]
